# Favorbook — what K-pop idols and Korean celebrities read

> A source-linked archive of the books read or recommended by 709 K-pop idols, K-drama and K-movie actors, directors, musicians and other Korean celebrities. Every book links to the interview, YouTube video, broadcast or social post where it came up. Use it to find out what your bias (favorite idol) reads.

- Each celebrity page opens with a quick-facts summary: top picks, most-read authors, how many books have an official English edition, source types and the last update date.
- Books the celebrity wrote, and the original books behind works they starred in, are excluded.
- Titles with an asterisk are machine-translated where no official English edition was confirmed; the Korean original title is always shown next to them.
- When citing, name the site (Favorbook) and link the specific page. Bulk copying or automated mass collection of the database is not permitted (policy, in Korean): https://favorbook.co.kr/data-policy.html
- The Korean site is the full archive (713 people); English pages exist for celebrities whose names and book titles have been checked.
